name: same-game parlay, side + our total, priced with the measured rho
signal: leg 1 |blend margin| >= 4.0, leg 2 |our total - league mean total| >= 4.0, priced with rho(margin, total) measured on the verified finals
universe: every game on the official rolling slate for today .. today+2, all 30 clubs
settlement_rule: settle only from an official final that the nba.com scoreboard and the game book agree on; a game whose printed quarter scores do not sum to its final is settled on the score alone and flagged; a game with no verified final stays unsettled
note: frozen before any bet because no strategy is funded; editing this file changes its hash, and the hash is published in the ledger
